diagrams.title: 加法：__add__

diagrams.source:
flowchart TD
    B["build_topo(v)"] --> Q{"v not in visited"}
    Q -->|是| V["visited.add(v)"]
    Q -->|否| R["return"]
    V --> F{"for child in v._prev"}
    F -->|还有 child| C["build_topo(child)"]
    C -->|recursion 返回| F
    F -->|for loop 结束| A["topo.append(v)"]
    A --> R
diagrams.title: build_topo(v)

diagrams.source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant X as build_topo(x)
    participant A as build_topo(a)
    participant B as build_topo(b)
    participant T as topo
    X->>A: build_topo(a)
    A->>T: topo.append(a)
    A-->>X: return
    X->>B: build_topo(b)
    B->>T: topo.append(b)
    B-->>X: return
    X->>T: topo.append(x)
    Note over T: [a,b,x]
diagrams.title: topo = [a,b,x]

diagrams.source:
flowchart TD T["topo = [a,b,x]"] --> R["reversed(topo)"] R --> O["[x,b,a]"] O --> V["v._backward()"] S["self.grad = 1
dL/dL = 1"] --> V V --> C["local derivative + chain rule"] C --> G["child 的gradient"]
diagrams.title: local derivative + chain rule
